notes.sowing: Sow thinly {cm:0.6} deep from 3 weeks before your last frost. Seed takes 2 to 3 weeks to come up, so keep the surface moist until it does. Always sow where the crop will grow, as the taproot does not transplant.
notes.care: Thin to {cm:5} to {cm:7.5} apart and water deeply about once a week. Soil hotter than about {c:29} gives pale roots. Sow again every 3 weeks until midsummer, and 10 to 12 weeks before your first fall frost for a fall crop.
notes.harvest: Lift once roots reach usable size, watering the day before to ease them out. Roots stand light frost, and fall carrots can stay under mulch to be dug as needed.
